note: [L] proves absolute summability by its own tree bound, YM.Push.AbsoluteSums.Gas.price_log (with Ursell.budget_root), applied in Song.summon on the chain to Boulevard.lays. The difference: the attachment smallness enters as the Ready field of Cash.Renewed (derived in Renewed.anew) rather than through the site-count estimate, and differentiated terms are carried by the supBounds of Collection.Local.

snippet.text:
theorem price_log (hr : Hard R) {n : Side} (X : ι → Support n) (B : ℕ)
    (ht : Tests R X) {a γ δ q : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (h : Ready X B (fun i => ‖w i‖) a γ δ q) :
    SumBudget (fun s => ‖value R w s‖) (Real.exp ((n.val^4:ℕ)*γ)) ∧
    SumBudget (fun i => ‖term R w i‖) (((n.val^4:ℕ)*γ)*(1-q)⁻¹) ∧
    Real.exp (logSum R w) = total R w ∧ 0 < total R w ∧ Real.log (total R w) = logSum R w := by
  have hX i : (X i).Nonempty := by obtain ⟨x,hx,-⟩ := ht i i (hr.diag i); exact ⟨x,hx⟩

proof_context.conclusion: Under Hard and the Ready attachment condition, the cluster values and connected terms of the hard overlap gas are absolutely summable with explicit budgets, exp(logSum) = total and log total = logSum.

snippet.text:
lemma budget_root (ht : Tests R X) {w u : ι → ℝ} {a γ δ q b : ℝ} (hu : ∀ i, 0 ≤ u i)
    (h : Ready X B w a γ δ q) (he : SumBudget (charge X B u (a+δ)) b)
    (m : ℕ) (i : Option (Fin m)) :
    SumBudget (fun z : Tuple ι m => atVertex R (charge X B w a) (charge X B u a) i z) (b*q^m) := by

proof_context.conclusion: Rooted tree sums of charged weights at a vertex are bounded by b*q^m.
